findings.ACCEPTANCE TEST: Create a custom record with nozzle temperatures (230-250 °C) and bed temperatures (80-90 °C). Kill the application process, reopen the app, and verify that the saved custom record retains all temperature values and provenance metadata.
findings.CONSEQUENCE: User-edited catalog records and custom filaments lose nozzle and bed temperature ranges upon saving. Process death or application restart clears these values, producing incomplete OpenSpool write intents missing temperature constraints.
findings.EVIDENCE: In app/src/main/kotlin/net/jamesjennison/spoolio/data/Databases.kt, the CustomRecord Room entity defines only id, brand, material, product, colorName, colorHex, diameterMm, massG, and updatedAt columns. In MainViewModel.kt, saveCustom() persists a CustomRecord and converts it back via asCatalogEntry(), which hardcodes all nozzle and bed temperature fields to null.
findings.FINDING: Custom and edited catalog records discard nozzle/bed temperatures, source revision, and per-field provenance during local database persistence.
findings.REQUIRED CORRECTION: Extend the CustomRecord database entity schema to store nozzleMinC, nozzleMaxC, bedMinC, bedMaxC, sourceRevision, and provenance metadata. Update CustomDialog and MainViewModel.saveCustom() to collect, validate, and persist temperature ranges and provenance.

findings.ACCEPTANCE TEST: Scan an OpenSpool tag containing temperature ranges, select 'Edit as a local record', and save the record without manual intervention; confirm that the local record saves successfully and retains the decoded temperatures.
findings.CONSEQUENCE: Tapping 'Edit as a local record' after reading a valid OpenSpool tag results in immediate validation failure upon saving, and any temperature parameters stored on the physical tag are silently lost.
findings.EVIDENCE: In MainViewModel.kt, decodedSeed() maps the decoded tag values into CustomSeed with color set to "" and omits min_temp, max_temp, bed_min_temp, and bed_max_temp. When saveCustom() is invoked, validateRecord() throws a ValidationException("Brand, material, product, and color are required").
findings.FINDING: Decoded OpenSpool tags fail validation when saved locally because OpenSpool NDEF payloads lack a color name field and decoded temperatures are ignored.
findings.REQUIRED CORRECTION: Modify decodedSeed() to extract min_temp, max_temp, bed_min_temp, and bed_max_temp from the decoded JsonValue map, provide a sensible default or derived color name when converting NDEF payloads, and update CustomDialog to expose temperature editing.

findings.ACCEPTANCE TEST: Select three distinct catalog and custom items, restart the app, and confirm that the main view renders the three recent items and allows selecting them for NFC write intent preparation.
findings.CONSEQUENCE: The application fails the core requirement to make recent records accessible in the UI, forcing users to re-search the catalog repeatedly for recently handled spools.
findings.EVIDENCE: In app/src/main/kotlin/net/jamesjennison/spoolio/data/Databases.kt, UserDao exposes recents(): Flow<List<Recent>>. MainViewModel.kt inserts records into recents in select(), but never queries or exposes store.user.user().recents() to MainActivity.kt.
findings.FINDING: Recents history is persisted to Room storage but is never retrieved or presented in the application UI.
findings.REQUIRED CORRECTION: Expose the recents Flow from MainViewModel and add a Recents list section to the UI in MainActivity.kt allowing immediate re-selection and editing of recently accessed items.
